name: What should I expect during a historical stucco assessment?

mainEntity.name: What should I expect during a historical stucco assessment?

acceptedAnswer.text: During a historical stucco assessment, a specialist will thoroughly examine the entire stucco surface, looking for cracks, delamination, efflorescence, water stains, and soft or crumbling areas. They will identify the type of stucco, its composition, and the number of layers. The assessment often involves sounding the walls to detect voids and using moisture meters to identify hidden water issues. The goal is to determine the extent of damage, its underlying causes, and to recommend appropriate, historically sensitive repair or restoration strategies.
acceptedAnswer.description: Expect a thorough examination of the stucco for damage, identification of stucco type and composition, and detection of moisture issues to determine repair needs.
